question: Taylor Swift scored a 2026 number-one hit with 'I Knew It, I Knew You', a song from the fifth film in which Pixar franchise?
source_excerpt: Taylor Swift’s ‘I Knew It, I Knew You’ Debuts at No. 1 on the Hot 100

extra.why_interesting: Players don't link Swift with a children's animated film. The clue 'fifth film' leaves only one Pixar series that has reached five films.

topicality.rationale: A chart-topping single tied to the summer Toy Story 5 release stays in conversation for about a season.

extra.verification_notes: Swift's 'I Knew It, I Knew You' is from Toy Story 5 and debuted at No. 1 on the Hot 100 in June 2026.

explanation: It came from Toy Story 5, so Swift's catalogue of chart-toppers now includes a song from the same franchise as Woody and Buzz.

question: In October 2026, Spider-Man: Brand New Day became only the third film ever to earn 2.5 billion dollars worldwide. One of the others is Avengers: Endgame. What is the third?
source_excerpt: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has now hit a cumulative global total of $2.506 billion

extra.why_interesting: Players may guess Titanic or a recent Avatar sequel. Only the original 2009 Avatar sits in that club with Endgame.

topicality.rationale: The box-office milestone is a news story that gets talked about for a few weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Brand New Day passed $2.5B in early Oct 2026 as the third film after Avatar and Endgame; no other film is above $2.5B (https://www.koimoi.com/box-office/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-tom-holland-starrer-joins-elite-2-5b-club-becomes-only-3rd-film-to-achieve-the-feat/).

explanation: The 2009 Avatar is the other member. Titanic and Avatar's own sequels both finished short of 2.5 billion dollars.

question: By October 2026, Spider-Man: Brand New Day had earned about 957 million dollars in North America and passed the film that had held the region's all-time record for over a decade. Which film was it?
source_excerpt: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Force Awakens at Domestic Box Office

extra.why_interesting: Most people assume Avatar or Endgame holds the North American record. In fact, the record had belonged to The Force Awakens since 2015.

topicality.rationale: A domestic box-office record being broken is a news item that fades within weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Brand New Day passed The Force Awakens (~$936.7M) as the all-time domestic leader on Sept 16, 2026; Force Awakens had held the record since early 2016.

explanation: Star Wars: The Force Awakens had led the North American chart since 2015 with about 936 million dollars, ahead of both Endgame and Avatar.

question: Netflix's Monster series turned in 2026 to Lizzie Borden, the Massachusetts woman tried in 1893 for the murder of her father and stepmother. According to the famous children's rhyme, what weapon did she use?
source_excerpt: Lizzie Borden took an axe and gave her mother forty whacks.

extra.why_interesting: The name sounds obscure, but the grim skipping rhyme about her is famous, and most players can half-recall it.

topicality.rationale: The hook is a new Monster season on Netflix, which stays topical for about a season; the answer itself is old trivia.

extra.verification_notes: Monster season 4 is The Lizzie Borden Story (2026), Borden was acquitted in 1893, and the rhyme 'Lizzie Borden took an axe' names an axe; no newer development changes this.

explanation: 'Lizzie Borden took an axe and gave her mother forty whacks', yet the jury acquitted her, and the case is still officially unsolved.

question: The 2026 blockbuster The Odyssey, a number one hit as far away as South Korea, follows a Greek king's ten-year struggle to get home after the Trojan War. Which island is he trying to reach?
source_excerpt: The Odyssey surpasses 10 million moviegoers in 33 days in Korea

extra.why_interesting: Everyone knows the hero wanders for years. Not everyone can name the small island he is trying to reach, though many half-remember it.

topicality.rationale: A major summer blockbuster release stays in conversation for about a season.

extra.verification_notes: The film is real and was No. 1 in South Korea; Odysseus's destination is Ithaca per the myth, and I found no newer event contradicting this (https://sbsstar.net/article/N1008740592/the-odyssey-surpasses-10-million-moviegoers-in-33-days-in-korea).

explanation: Odysseus is king of Ithaca, a small island in the Ionian Sea, where his wife Penelope spends twenty years fending off suitors.

question: The 2026 re-release of Avengers: Endgame added four new scenes that lead into the next Avengers film. In it, Robert Downey Jr. returns to Marvel, but not as Iron Man. Which masked villain does he play?
source_excerpt: Avengers Endgame: Encore has four new scenes that link to Doomsday

extra.why_interesting: The actor who played Marvel's best-loved hero returns as one of its greatest villains, which is a jolt even to casual fans.

topicality.rationale: Re-release scenes promoting the next Avengers film are short-lived promotional news.

extra.verification_notes: Coverage of Avengers: Endgame Encore (opened Sept 25, 2026) says it has four new scenes leading into Doomsday and that Downey Jr. appears as Doctor Doom; no contradicting newer developments found.

explanation: Downey plays Victor von Doom, the armoured ruler of Latveria and the Fantastic Four's arch-enemy, a complete reversal of the hero who died saving the universe.

question: A 2026 Oasis documentary takes its name from the band's 1996 anthem 'Don't Look Back in Anger'. Unusually for an Oasis single, frontman Liam Gallagher doesn't sing lead on it. Who does?
source_excerpt: Noel Gallagher sings lead; Liam is credited with tambourine and backing vocals. It was the first Oasis single sung by Noel rather than Liam.

extra.why_interesting: Fans assume frontman Liam sings every Oasis anthem. One of their very biggest is sung by the guitarist and songwriter brother.

topicality.rationale: A new Oasis documentary after the reunion is a release that stays topical for about a season.

extra.verification_notes: Noel Gallagher sings lead on 'Don't Look Back in Anger' (his first Oasis lead single), and the 2026 documentary 'Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger' exists.

explanation: Noel wrote and sang it, and it became one of the few Oasis singles with his voice on lead, later turned into a crowd singalong across Britain.

question: Konami's horror series Silent Hill returned with Townfall in 2026. Which monster from the series, a hulking executioner whose head is hidden inside a huge rusty metal triangle, became its most famous icon?
source_excerpt: Silent Hill Townfall is planned for a 24 September 2026 release on Windows PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store alongside PS5.

extra.why_interesting: Even people who never played the games have seen the image of the creature with the huge metal triangle for a head. Its plain, literal name feels obvious once you hear it.

topicality.rationale: A new Silent Hill game release stays topical for about a season; Pyramid Head itself is evergreen trivia.

extra.verification_notes: Pyramid Head is the iconic Silent Hill monster, and Townfall is a 2026 release (24 Sept 2026) per https://stevivor.com/news/silent-hill-townfall-release-date-set-for-24-september-2026; nothing contradicts the pair.

explanation: Pyramid Head stalked players in Silent Hill 2 back in 2001, and his great knife and metal helmet have made him one of gaming's best-known monsters.
